description: First distributed X3 gate. Stage order follows the cluster pipeline: build, then fuzz / simulation / GPU / inference in parallel. Every command is a real repo command; each job runs at the same exact commit in a throwaway worktree on the node that owns its class (or the control node, labelled LOCAL-FALLBACK, when that node does not exist yet).

jobs.name: fuzz-atomic-kernel-rollback
jobs.cmd: mkdir -p "$X3_JOB_OUT/crashes" "$X3_JOB_OUT/corpus" && cd pallets/x3-atomic-kernel && cargo +nightly-2026-08-21 fuzz run fuzz_rollback "$X3_JOB_OUT/corpus" -- -max_total_time=120 -seed=1 -artifact_prefix="$X3_JOB_OUT/crashes/"

jobs.name: inference-workers
jobs.cmd: for p in $(ss -H -ltn | awk '{print $4}' | sed -n 's/.*:\(114[34][0-9]\)$/\1/p' | grep -vx 11435 | sort -u); do curl -fsS -m 300 http://127.0.0.1:$p/api/generate -d '{"model":"qwen2.5-coder:7b","prompt":"Reply with the single word: ok","stream":false,"options":{"num_predict":8}}' -o "$X3_JOB_OUT/worker-$p.json" || { echo "worker :$p failed"; exit 1; }; echo "worker :$p ok"; done; ls "$X3_JOB_OUT"/worker-*.json
